# Funny Creepers!
![screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/57716957227df914fbfc13e4d9b91fea8afc5629.png)
## About mod
This mod changes creepers to funny ones, with a cool rolling animation.
### Compability
Works on ANY version.
### Dependencies
Needs OptiFine or EMF & ATF
### ❗Important❗
Also come and check out other resource packs on my profile, there are even cooler ones there
### Beta
This is a beta version of the mod, which may contain some bugs and omissions.
